pages.title: Feed and heat
pages.text: The Trichlorosilane Distillation Tower refines crude feed into purified trichlorosilane. Supply power and magma heat to maintain its target temperature of 300.$(br2)Continuous operation builds column stability and shortens runs in high-purity mode.

pages.title: Operating mode
pages.text: High-purity mode favors yield, and column stability shortens its duration. In the built-in recipe, high-throughput mode turns four crude units into three purified units and one residue in half the base recipe duration.$(br2)Choose a mode before the batch starts and keep output space available.

pages.title: Material loop
pages.text: Send purified trichlorosilane to the $(l:siliconic:siemens_reactor)Siemens reactor$(/l). Return distillation residue to the $(l:siliconic:chemical_recycler)chlorosilane recycler$(/l) to recover crude feed.$(br2)Maintain power, heat, feed, and output space for continuous operation. Idle or interrupted operation lowers stability.
